gloss: Zenkō-ji, a major Buddhist temple in Nagano

definitions.explanation: A large Buddhist temple in the city of {長野|ながの}, founded in the seventh century and open to all sects. Its main Buddha image is kept hidden, and a copy is shown to the public only once every seven years; pilgrims have come from all over Japan for centuries.

CULTURAL NOTE:
- The temple's main image is never shown; a copy is displayed in the {御開帳|ごかいちょう}, held once every seven years (counted inclusively, so every six calendar years), which draws millions of visitors.
